name: DESIGNER
summary: Design a rig by talking to an agent and watching the topology assemble.

surface.hint: say what the rig should do; watch it take shape, then build it

_drive_note: Uses the runtime's own drive channel (capabilities drive.read/drive.write), so there is no provider and nothing in `calls`: `calls` declares verbs a PROVIDER must answer, and naming a runtime verb there makes the box refuse to start because nothing installs a provider for it. Ops carry INTENT, never DOM instructions, per contract/drive.md: {designer:{action:'set-rig'|'add-pod'|'add-seat'|'set-seat'|'remove'|'set-spec'|'reset', ...}}. The vocabulary is this surface's alone; the runtime never interprets it.
